active_authority.historical_plan: AP-001/AP-001_PLAN_FROZEN.md is preserved as historical WP1 authority only

dependencies.required_before_execution: WP2 artifacts are frozen and their hashes are recorded in the WP3 preflight

inherits.wp1_contract: AP-001/R1_CONTRACT/AP-001_WP1_CONTRACT.json (causal clock, development partition, D-006 anchor rule, boundary evidence)
inherits.wp2_contract: AP-001/R2_LIFECYCLE_MARKET/AP-001_WP2_CONTRACT.json (anchor table, native tick clock, separate seven-scale bar bridge, availability_evidence/sidecar_binding, support/noise reference, block rules)
inherits.boundary_and_warm_state: WP2 boundary_and_warm_state is inherited; WP1's one left-truncated episode remains flagged and no warm-state proof is invented

objective: Determine how causally-available tick context changes the anchor (conditioning) and how the tick-detector system evolves after the anchor (co-evolution), per plan §6, on the development leaf only.

quote_pressure.post_anchor: alignment change, opposition change, persistence, reversal timing

bar_bridge.role: separate bounded outcome layer inherited from WP2; never replaces or pools with native tick outcomes
bar_bridge.alignment: count only the first fully post-anchor native bar defined by WP2: interval start strictly after anchor event_ts_ns and verified bar availability key strictly after anchor (received_ts_ns, source_sequence); exclude partial/pre-anchor bars

native_clock_and_bridge.no_future_conditioning: At-anchor conditioning uses only payload values lawfully available at the WP2 anchor. Post-anchor context transitions and bar/structural events are outcomes or sequence evidence; prospective re-anchors use their own later lawful availability.

support_rule.low_support_fallback: 150-299 effective observations only, predeclared LOW_SUPPORT_FALLBACK, with at least 3 UTC calendar-month blocks each containing at least 50 effective observations and the frozen block sign/breadth/dominance checks
support_rule.effective_unit: matched or paired analytical units after conditioning, causal eligibility, exclusions, and missingness; never raw rows

rule_11_lineage_adjudication.rule: Before any Drift-Burst same-domain relationship is described as independent, additive, confluence, or promoted, adjudicate each named pair separately.
rule_11_lineage_adjudication.contract_freeze_status: UNRESOLVED_LINEAGE until the WP3 artifact records an evidence-backed status for every named pair

special_rules.feed_health: quality instrumentation and contamination control only by default; not an independent vote
special_rules.spread_state: market/trading condition only by default; not an independent vote
special_rules.unresolved: UNRESOLVED_LINEAGE cannot promote confluence or independent confirmation

rule_11_lineage_adjudication.evidence: Use producer field lineage, lawful availability, and observed semantics. Detector names alone do not establish independence.

step_0_payload_inventory.purpose: before any behavioral scan, inventory every field of the six context payloads from a deterministic sample of the development leaf
step_0_payload_inventory.output: AP-001/R3_TICK_CONTEXT/AP-001_WP3_PAYLOAD_DICTIONARY.json — per detector: field, type, state-vs-measurement classification, availability semantics (live vs episode-scoped), nullability
step_0_payload_inventory.rule: fields whose availability semantics cannot be established causally are excluded from anchor-time conditioning and marked accordingly

question_class_A_conditioning.snapshot: at each WP2 anchor tick, parse all six context payloads present at the anchor availability key (received_ts_ns, source_sequence); event_ts_ns is provenance only; missing payload or unresolved availability is explicit missingness and the anchor stays in the denominator
question_class_A_conditioning.continuous_handling: raw values retained; readable quintile bands per WP2 band rule (edges frozen in reference artifact); band tables are summaries only
question_class_A_conditioning.output: AP-001/R3_TICK_CONTEXT/AP-001_WP3_CONDITIONING_TABLES.json — per family x anchor state x outcome: support, block table, effect vs WP2 reference, INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT marking per reference rules

question_class_B_coevolution.window: post-anchor until episode end or +300s, whichever first; detector changes after t are outcomes, never anchor-time information
measurements: per family: first transition after anchor, transition latency, full transition sequence counts
event order vs price: whether family transition precedes/follows the anchor window's MFE/MAE timing
aligned vs conflicting emergence: families agreeing/opposing the anchor direction over time; system convergence/divergence/mixed classification
cross-block recurrence: sequence stability by month block and session block
question_class_B_coevolution.reanchor_candidates: post-anchor detector events that repeatedly precede a price outcome are LISTED only (family, event, outcome, support, blocks); they become prospective re-anchor questions in their own lawful study, not usable information here

quality_control.feed_health: degraded/contaminated anchors flagged; analyses report quality-excluded variants where the family role requires it
quality_control.missingness: per-family anchor coverage reported; no silent drops

missingness.rule: Report per-family and per-outcome missingness, quality exclusions, left/right-boundary censoring, and unresolved availability without imputation or silent denominator changes.

determinism.rerun: Repeat the deterministic development scan in a fresh process; canonical output hashes must match before interpretation.
determinism.ordering: Sort tables by family, anchor state, anchor availability key, native scale, outcome, and stable event key before canonical serialization.
determinism.record: Record contract/input/artifact hashes, code identity, effective-unit counts, missingness counts, lineage statuses, and runtime in WP3 preflight.

exit_condition: Every tick family ends with an anchor-context result and a post-anchor sequence result, or an explicit null / insufficient-support / quality-excluded status; payload dictionary complete; determinism hashes match.
interpretation_boundary: Tables are frozen, then interpreted by the analyst. No scanner change after seeing results (defect protocol excepted). WP3 is discovery only: no candidate promotion, independent confluence claim, or activation decision.
change_rule: Deviations require decision-log entries and director approval before affected evidence is used.
